description_en: Refreshes cached content by cache tag in Edge Routine (ER) scenarios
description_zh: ER场景下的cache tag粒度的刷新接口
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn refresh-er-object-caches-by-cache-tag --domain example.com --cache-tag tag1,tag2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefreshErObjectCachesByCacheTag

parameters.help_en: The fetch domain name used when the Edge Routine (ER) component initiates a fetch request after receiving a client request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端请求打到ER组件，ER组件发起Fetch请求时使用的Fetch域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The cache tags. Separate multiple cache tags with commas
parameters.help_zh: 缓存标签。多个用逗号隔开
parameters.name: cache_tag

parameters.help_en:
The domain names for merged refresh. During a refresh operation, the scheduling domain nodes of the domain names are merged for the refresh.
Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
合并刷新域名，刷新的时候会合并域名的调度域节点进行刷新。
多个域名之间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: merge_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to refresh the resources within the specified scope when the back-to-origin content is identical to the origin server resource. Default value: false.
true: Refreshes all resources within the specified scope. If you select Refresh All Resources and a user request matches a resource within the specified scope, the Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) point of presence (POP) directly fetches the latest resource from the origin server, returns it to the user, and recaches the resource.
false: Refreshes only the modified resources within the specified scope. If you select Refresh Modified Resources and a user request matches a resource within the specified scope, the DCDN point of presence fetches the Last-Modified header of the resource from the origin server. If the header matches the cached resource, the DCDN point of presence returns the cached resource. If the header does not match, the DCDN point of presence fetches the latest resource from the origin server, returns it to the user, and recaches the resource.
This parameter takes effect for all refresh types except file refresh
parameters.help_zh:
当回源内容和源站资源对比一致时，是否刷新对应范围内的资源。默认为false。
true：刷新对应范围内的全部资源。选择 “刷新全部资源” 时，如果用户请求的内容匹配到了对应范围内的资源，DCDN节点将会直接回源拉取新资源返回给用户，并重新缓存该资源。
false：刷新对应范围内发生变更的资源。选择 “刷新变更资源” 时，如果用户请求的内容匹配到了对应范围内的资源，DCDN节点将会回源获取资源的 Last-Modified 信息，若与当前缓存资源一致，则直接返回已缓存资源，若不一致，则回源拉取新资源返回给用户，并重新缓存该资源。
此参数生效范围：除文件刷新外的刷新类型
parameters.name: force

RefreshTaskId.description_en: The ID of the refresh task returned
